target.title: refactor(ui): localize formatHourLabel in usage metrics module
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`formatHourLabel` is listed in the barrel `export { ... }` block of `ui/src/pages/usage/metrics.ts` but has zero importers outside its own module within the `ui/` package. The unnecessary export widens the module's public API surface.

## Why This Change Was Made

Removed `formatHourLabel` from the barrel export block. The function is referenced only within `metrics.ts` itself — zero external imports within `ui/`.

Zero runtime behavior change. Matches the pattern established by #102793 (`refactor(ui): localize internal declarations`).

## User Impact

No user impact. Purely internal visibility change.

## Evidence

**Real environment tested:** Node v24, local OpenClaw checkout, PR head commit.

**Proof — zero external consumers within ui/:**

```
$ git grep "\bformatHourLabel\b" -- 'ui/**/*.ts' 'ui/**/*.tsx'
ui/src/pages/usage/metrics.ts:31:function formatHourLabel(hour: number): string {
ui/src/pages/usage/metrics.ts:133:      label: formatHourLabel(entry.hour),
# ← 全部在 metrics.ts 自身内（barrel 行已删除）
```

```
npx oxlint ui/src/pages/usage/metrics.ts
# exit 0

git diff upstream/main --stat
# 1 file changed, 1 deletion(-)
```

**Full UI build proof:**

```
$ cd ui && pnpm run build
✓ built in 1.46s

$ git diff --check
# exit 0
```

**Observed result after fix:** `formatHourLabel` is no longer part of the module's public API. Full UI production build succeeds with zero errors.

**What was not tested:** None — the change has zero runtime surface to verify beyond build and lint.

## Regression Test Plan

- `npx oxlint ui/src/pages/usage/metrics.ts` — **exit 0**
- `cd ui && pnpm run build` — **✓ built in 1.46s**
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/usage/view.test.ts --run` — **7 passed** (1 pre-existing failure unrelated to this change)
- `git diff upstream/main --stat` — **1 file, -1/-0**

## Root Cause

`formatHourLabel` was exported via the barrel block but never imported by any other module. Per AGENTS.md: "Keep APIs narrow: export only current caller needs; keep types/helpers local by default."
